Object.Title: Great seal of the United Kingdom
Object.Description: The seal of Henry III of England. The seal depicts the king robed and crowned, seated on his throne holding a sceptre in his right hand and an orb with a cross in his left. The king is stepping on two small lions, which are visible in front of the lower part of the throne.
Object.Text: HENRICVS DEI GRACIA REX ANGLIE DOMINVS HIBERNIE DVX AQUITANIE
